title: ISO 4210-2:2023 — Requirements for city and trekking, young adult, mountain and racing bicycles
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. The public ISO listing identifies ISO 4210-2:2023 (edition 3, 2023-01) as specifying safety and performance requirements for the design, assembly and testing of bicycles and sub-assemblies, for young adult (maximum saddle height 635 to under 750 mm), city and trekking, mountain and racing bicycles (maximum saddle height 635 mm or more, including folding bicycles), and excluding specialized types such as delivery bicycles, recumbents and tandems. The paid standard text and any test report were not accessed.
